rows.value: Score 0–2 per criterion. Scores are RELATIVE to your portfolio, not absolute quality ratings.
2 = directly supports a declared strategic initiative · 1 = indirect / supportive · 0 = not linked to strategy
2 = process is broken/urgent, errors or delays cause real damage · 1 = annoying inefficiency · 0 = minor
2 = affects many people or processes, high frequency · 1 = moderate · 0 = small
2 = clear quantifiable hours/$ (can be modeled in the ROI model) · 1 = some, harder to quantify · 0 = mostly soft
2 = data/access/systems ready, no blockers · 1 = partial or moderate prep work · 0 = significant blockers (data, compliance, legacy)
2 = low effort, reuse of existing tools/platform possible · 1 = moderate build or buy · 0 = complex, multi-system, high cost
2 = risk grows over time (compliance, cost, attrition) · 1 = moderate · 0 = low
2 = needed this quarter · 1 = needed this year · 0 = can wait
- Who scores: EPO with the process owner; portfolio view resolves conflicts between opportunities.
- HIGH (≥12): start Phase 1 discovery and build a business case.
- MEDIUM (9–11): keep on the list; compare against other opportunities before committing discovery capacity.
- LOW (<9): defer or reject; revisit deferred items quarterly.
- Pair with the intake template (one intake per opportunity) and the ROI model once the case gets serious.
